# Bricks of India
> LEGO® price comparison, reviews, news and guides for India.

## What this site offers
- Price comparison for LEGO sets across Indian stores: lego.in and Toycra
- Deals: LEGO sets currently selling below MRP in India
- Independent set reviews with an India-specific verdict and INR prices
- LEGO news written for Indian fans
- Guides for buying and collecting LEGO in India
- The Lab: free LEGO tools built for India

## Key sections
- [Sets](https://bricksofindia.com/sets): every LEGO set, with Indian store prices where a store lists it
- [Deals](https://bricksofindia.com/deals): sets currently selling below MRP
- [Themes](https://bricksofindia.com/themes): sets by theme
- [Reviews](https://bricksofindia.com/reviews): set reviews with an India verdict
- [News](https://bricksofindia.com/news): LEGO news for India
- [Guides](https://bricksofindia.com/guides): buying and collecting guides
- [Opinion](https://bricksofindia.com/opinion): commentary on the Indian LEGO hobby
- [Community](https://bricksofindia.com/community): Indian builder spotlights
- [Minifig HQ](https://bricksofindia.com/minifig-hq): minifigures
- [The Lab](https://bricksofindia.com/lab): Biryani Index, India Deals Today, Price Drops, Which Set Are You?, CMF Tracker, Budget Calculator, Retiring Soon
- [About](https://bricksofindia.com/about)
- [Contact](https://bricksofindia.com/contact)
